assume_role_policy.description: Trust policy document (JSON) defining who can assume the role

name_prefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated role name (conflicts with name)

path.description: Path to the role (for organizational hierarchy)

force_detach_policies.name: force_detach_policies

managed_policy_arns.name: managed_policy_arns

tags.name: tags
